from collections import deque
def flood(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    seeds=[(i,j,v) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (0,1)]
    for si,sj,v in seeds:
        seen=set(); q=deque([(si,sj)])
        while q:
            i,j=q.popleft()
            if (i,j) in seen: continue
            seen.add((i,j))
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
                if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and g[ni][nj]==1 and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                    out[ni][nj]=v; q.append((ni,nj))
    return out
